'''Galven tubing'''<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> or a '''galven tube''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a component used in [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]<ref name="SSR" /> and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].<ref name="EGWT" /> During maintenance of a blaster rifle, the galven tubing had to be polished.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
